hooks.text: 亲手锻造抛光装备再上架售卖
hooks.excerpt: Here, you'll need to roll up your sleeves—and wave your paws—to personally hammer cold metal into top-tier weapons, sturdy armor, and impenetrable shields. Polish them until they sparkle before displaying them on your shelves.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 招募专长猫员工接管锻造与研发
hooks.excerpt: Recruit a diverse crew of cats with specialized skills (or those just looking to earn some extra kibble) to optimize your production line. From daily hammering to advanced blueprint research—and even secret feline technologies only cats understand—you can trust your staff to handle the grind.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 武装冒险队带回材料并揭开魔龙真相
hooks.excerpt: Organize your best-armed adventurer squads or head to the guild to post bounties, dispatching them into the depths to hunt for rare crafting materials. As your heroes bring back epic loot, you will piece together the dark truth behind the Demon Dragon.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
